title: Power Platform Security and Advisor
summary: Managed security for Power Platform: Security Hub, advanced connector policies replacing DLP, customer-managed keys, VNet, tenant isolation, Defender for Copilot Studio, and compliance.
whyItMatters: Governance and security tooling is consolidating; ACP replaces DLP.

keyPoints.heading: Security Hub
keyPoints.text: Single pane of glass: proactive rules, recommendations, safe defaults, risk prioritization. Hierarchy: Security Hub > environment groups > environments.

keyPoints.heading: Advanced connector policies
keyPoints.text: Replacing DLP; control individual connector actions (e.g., Dataverse read not write); environments and groups; extends to MCP servers/tools.

keyPoints.heading: Data protection
keyPoints.text: Customer-managed keys with rotation and private link; Azure VNet injection for plug-ins and selected connectors; agent knowledge and privacy controls.

keyPoints.heading: Identity and access
keyPoints.text: IP firewall, tenant isolation (default on for new tenants since April 2026), IP cookie binding, sharing limits and environment routing, app access control, require Entra ID for agents.

keyPoints.heading: Threat detection
keyPoints.text: Microsoft Defender for Copilot Studio (prompt injection protection; requires license); turn off embedded maker credentials.

keyPoints.heading: Compliance
keyPoints.text: Auditing to Purview, Customer Lockbox; Power Pages is the only product in Security Hub today.
